_about: The one list the help is built from: the sidebar and its order, each page's title and summary, the search index, the sitemap and llms.txt. A page is site/help/<slug>.md; add it here and Tools/Site/build_site.py picks it up.

pages.title: Browse your machines
pages.summary: How the library is laid out on each device, how to search it, and what a host's details and this device's host show.

pages.title: Add a machine and its services
pages.summary: Add a host with a Terminal, Database or Desktop service, add more services, edit them, and remove services or hosts.

pages.title: Connect and switch between sessions
pages.summary: Use the Connect controls, choose which service opens, and switch to or close open sessions from Active and the lightning button.

pages.title: Favorites, collections and other names
pages.summary: Mark favorites, find recent hosts, group hosts into collections, and give a host other names that search and matching use.

pages.title: Manage SSH keys
pages.summary: Import keys or generate them in the Secure Enclave, see which services use a key, and copy, export, rename or delete keys.

pages.title: Your library on all your devices
pages.summary: What iCloud syncs and what stays on one device, when syncing happens, how to check its status, and how conflicts resolve.

pages.title: Settings and window appearance
pages.summary: Open Settings on each device, set window opacity and glass, and read the General, Privacy and About pages.

pages.title: Connect to a machine over SSH
pages.summary: Set up a Terminal service, connect, enter passwords, route through jump hosts, allow legacy algorithms, and recover from dropped connections.

pages.title: Sign in with keys and trust host keys
pages.summary: Sign in with an SSH or Secure Enclave key, install your public key, and trust or refuse a machine's host key.

pages.title: Work in a terminal
pages.summary: Terminal windows, tabs and splits, moving tabs between windows, what comes back after a relaunch, Show All Terminals, the tools menu, text size, search, paste review, snippets, recording and the Mac's local shell.

pages.title: Keep terminals running with tmux
pages.summary: Keep each terminal in its own tmux session, reconnect to it, pick it up from Active on another device, and end it.

pages.title: Browse and transfer files over SFTP
pages.summary: Open the file browser, upload and download, create, rename, move and delete items, and edit remote files in the Editor.

pages.title: Forward ports through an SSH session
pages.summary: Add local, remote and SOCKS5 port forwards to a live SSH session, start and stop them, and fix common failures.

pages.title: Save and open terminal Workgroups
pages.summary: Create Workgroups of terminal tabs with startup commands, open them on each platform, and swap in SSH for Mac-only local tabs.

pages.title: Terminal settings, themes and snippets
pages.summary: The Connections, Terminal and Snippets settings pages, theme editing, a terminal window's own settings, SSH config import and Tailscale.

pages.title: Add a database service
pages.summary: Add a MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQLite database to a host, fill in its fields, and make it read-only.

pages.title: Encryption and the SSH tunnel
pages.summary: Turn on TLS, choose how the certificate is verified, understand the unencrypted warning, and connect through the host's SSH service.

pages.title: The database workspace
pages.summary: Connect, browse databases and schemas, read the overview and charts, use schema commands and the Mutation Log, reconnect, and give a window its own settings.

pages.title: Browse table data
pages.summary: Switch table views, sort, filter and page rows, manage columns, analyze, follow foreign keys and export.

pages.title: See a database's diagram
pages.summary: Every table, column and foreign key as a live diagram, in three dimensions on Vision Pro.

pages.title: Edit rows and structure
pages.summary: Edit, add, delete and paste rows with a review before every write, and change columns, indexes and foreign keys.

pages.title: Write and run SQL
pages.summary: Run statements, use Explain Plan, cancel and format, save .sql files, and use query history with literal redaction.

pages.title: The on-device assistant
pages.summary: Generate SQL, get suggested fixes and automatic tab titles from the on-device model, and see exactly what it is given.

pages.title: Add a remote desktop
pages.summary: Add an RDP or VNC Desktop service to a host, what each field means, and how to edit or remove it.

pages.title: Import an RDP file
pages.summary: Turn a .rdp file into a host with a Desktop service, what the import keeps, and which files it refuses.

pages.title: Sign in and trust a remote computer
pages.summary: NLA and TLS fallback, VNC password or Mac account sign-in, verifying RDP certificates, and what is not supported.

pages.title: Connect to and leave a remote desktop
pages.summary: Open a desktop, enter a password when asked, read status and failures, reconnect, give a desktop window its own settings, and close a session.

pages.title: Remote desktops on Apple Vision Pro
pages.summary: The desktop window's controls, headset input, glass opacity and strength, and removing the remote background.

pages.title: Resolution, scaling and zoom
pages.summary: Match Window Size, Detail, fixed resolutions, several displays and a window for each, Screen Sharing quality and what the network carries, and zooming the image in the window.

pages.title: Keyboard, pointer, clipboard and audio
pages.summary: Typing, key buttons, pointer modes and gestures, exchanging clipboard text, and remote audio.

pages.title: Open the Editor
pages.summary: Ways into the Editor on each platform, what an editor window holds, new documents, and how to leave or close it.

pages.title: Work with Projects
pages.summary: Open folders on this device or on a server as projects, manage the Projects list, and how it syncs between devices.

pages.title: Files, Folders and Tabs
pages.summary: Browse a project's files, preview and keep tabs, create new files locally or on a server, and open files on their own.

pages.title: Save Your Work
pages.summary: Save with ⌘S or the toolbar, choose where a new document goes, handle files that changed, and close unsaved documents.

pages.title: Languages, Find and the Status Bar
pages.summary: The 15 highlighted languages and their extensions, changing a file's language, the status bar, Go to Line, and Find and Replace.

pages.title: Preview and Viewers
pages.summary: Preview Markdown with Mermaid diagrams, HTML, SVG and CSV, and view images, PDFs, video and audio.

pages.title: Editor Settings
pages.summary: Text size, line numbers and wrapping at four levels: the Editor's defaults, a window, a project, and a single file; and a window's own glass.
